collections.name: BIBOO FEATHER
collections.description:
🪶 BIBOO FEATHER

BIBOO FEATHER is a minimalist NFT collection centered around the simple yet elegant beauty of a feather.

Featuring a distinctive feather design against a vibrant #CCFF00 background, this collection embraces simplicity, contrast, and individuality.

A feather can symbolize freedom, lightness, and the courage to follow your own path. Through a clean and minimal design, BIBOO FEATHER gives this timeless symbol a unique digital identity.

No unnecessary details. Just a feather, a color, and a symbol with meaning.

BIBOO FEATHER — A symbol of freedom.

collections.name: BIBOO HEYHOOD
collections.description:
🟢 BIBOO HEYHOOD

BIBOO HEYHOOD is a minimalist NFT collection inspired by street culture and the spirit of the hood.

Featuring the phrase “HEY, HOOD!” in black against a vibrant #CCFF00 background, this collection keeps things simple while making a bold statement.

No characters. No illustrations. No unnecessary details. Just two words, one striking color, and an attitude that speaks for itself.

HEYHOOD is more than a greeting. It's a little expression of street identity, individuality, and connection.

BIBOO HEYHOOD — Keep it simple. Keep it real.

collections.name: BIBOO SPORE

🍄 BIBOO SPORE

Welcome to BIBOO SPORE, a whimsical world of mushroom-inspired characters where nature meets imagination. Each BIBOO has its own unique appearance, personality, and charm, inspired by the mysterious beauty of fungi and enchanted forests.

From colorful mushroom caps to curious expressions and unusual designs, every character brings something different to this little world. Cute, strange, and full of life, BIBOO SPORE celebrates individuality through a collection of unique mushroom-themed PFPs.

Step into the world of spores, discover your favorite BIBOO, and let your imagination grow.

🍄 One spore, endless possibilities.

collections.name: Facets
collections.description:
FACETS is an art collection of 2,222 pieces built on seven distinct personas from the web3 space, each with its own story and characteristics. Fully on-chain and animated, drawn in Solidity as pixel blocks on a 35x35 grid.

It carries two mechanics: Burn to Forge, and The Turn, which shares royalties with holders. Every piece also turns toward the wallet holding it and is redrawn when it changes hands, and each one carries a name from a book of 832, written by hand.
